<a name="Attach"></a>
## func [Attach](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/versions/versions.go#L24>)

```go
func Attach(s *model.Secret, target *model.Version, stages []string) error
```

Attach moves each requested label to target. Moving AWSCURRENT also moves AWSPREVIOUS to its former owner. See API\_PutSecretValue.html. Call within Store.UpdateSecret so a subsequent quota error rolls back all label moves.

<a name="Prune"></a>
## func [Prune](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/versions/versions.go#L59>)

```go
func Prune(s *model.Secret, now time.Time) error
```

Prune retains at most 100 versions, removing the oldest deprecated versions first. AWS never removes labeled versions or versions less than 24 hours old. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/getting-started.html#term_version Call within Store.UpdateSecret; errors must roll back the enclosing mutation.
